verdicts.decision_note: The client confirms that the PCB requires an external LED backlight for the e-paper display.
The resistor specification and intended backlight current and power remain materially unresolved for circuit implementation.

The client specifies the backlight driver, PWM control, boot-off biasing, supply selection, decoupling, resistor population, diode omission, and expected current; replay leaves no incompatible prior attributes requiring removal.
The detailed circuit specification resolves the implementation-blocking value ambiguity and returns the backlight requirement to active work.
